end.summary:
Practised levels of organisation in humans and plants: cell, tissue, organ, organ system, organism.
Gave human examples such as blood cell, muscle tissue, heart, and digestive system.
Initially mixed up an organ with an organ system; corrected this later using heart and digestive-system examples (correctAfterLastSeen).
Recalled that cells group to form tissue, then organs, and then organ systems; ordering remained partly incomplete.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the levels of organisation and used the heart and digestive system to clarify the difference between one organ and a group of organs. Yash explained that muscle cells form muscle tissue and then help form the heart; the organ-versus-system mix-up was corrected later in the lesson. At home, they can write the five levels in order and add one example beside each for a homework answer.
